name: NPCTemplateCommandSet
description: NPC: view templates, view filters and object styles for building project templates

commands.description: List view templates with their main settings and how many views use each
Read a view template's settings: includes, category visibility and overrides, filters, view range
Create a view template from a view, or duplicate an existing template
Change view template properties: scale, detail level, view range, parameters, included settings
Set category visibility and graphic overrides on view templates or views
Assign, remove, or apply once a view template on views
List view filters with their categories, rules and the templates that use them
Create or update a rule-based view filter
Add, update, remove or reorder view filters on view templates or views
Report which views use which template, which have none, and where they are on sheets
Read object styles and line styles: line weights, color, pattern, material
Change object styles, or create subcategories and line styles
